newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia hopes to raise $900 mln from privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Serbia hopes to raise $900 mln from privatisation.

text.p: Serbia hopes to raise at least $900 million through forthcoming privatisation, a government official said on Tuesday.

"If only one percent of all shares subscribed in the first round of privatisation are paid in, we hope to raise around $900 million," Miroljub Hadzic, assistant to the Serbian Privatisation Minister, told Reuters.
This was the first time that Serbia revealed its expectations from the upcoming privatisation process.
The government insists it is not the money but a clearer ownership structure it expects from the process, hoped to push the country further into economic reforms.
"This means that the estimated value of socially-owned capital which will be transformed by the new Serbian Law on Ownership Transformation is close to $90 billion," he added.
Earlier estimates put the value of Serbian companies to be privatised between 60 and 70 billion German marks.

Government economists insisted the value ranged from as low as 30 billion German marks to as high as 130 billion German marks, depending on the capital evaluation method. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
